//test: --conditions=import is required because @zunialab/interchain publishes an exports map with only `types` and `import`. Node's CJS resolver (which tsx routes .ts through in a non-module package) looks for `require` or `default`, finds neither, and refuses the package. Adding `"default": "./dist/index.js"` to that package's exports map is the real fix; this flag makes the tests run against the package as it is published today.
